_meta.purpose: Pre-resolved registry values for downstream agents. Agents consuming this file do NOT need to load raw registry files.

spec_identity.notes: New spec family for exterior fiber cement siding repaint (combined assessment + prep + prime + finish). Context prefix FCRP (FiberCement RePaint) confirmed — no collision with existing prefixes. TSK_FCSD_* is consumed by NC fiber cement siding (25 tasks). TSK_FCRP_* has zero existing usage. MOD_FCRP_* has zero existing usage. Verified against all context_prefixes_in_use: CLOSET_SHELF, FRAME, DOOR, CEIL, WALL, TRIM, WIN, STRS, WNSC, WDWL, WDCL, ARCH, BLTN, CABT, SDNG, FCSD, XTRM, SFIT, XWIN, TRRP, DRRP, WNRP, XWRP, SFRP. FCRP is unique.

paintable_items.name: Exterior siding field surface
paintable_items.notes: Reuse existing item from SF_SIDING_FIBERCEMENT_EXT_NC and SF_WOOD_SIDING_EXT_NC_PAINT. Same physical surface in RP context — net paintable siding field area. Profile and texture modifiers adjust effective production rates. No phase suffix needed — single combined spec.

task_prefix.collision_check: No collision. TSK_FCSD_* is NC fiber cement siding (25 tasks). TSK_SDNG_* is NC wood siding (30 tasks). TSK_FCRP_* has zero existing usage in id_registry.json context_prefixes_in_use. FCRP is unique for fiber cement repaint. Pattern: FC = fiber cement, RP = repaint.
task_prefix.naming_rule: TSK_FCRP_{ACTION} — action should be verb-based. ALL tasks in this combined RP spec use the FCRP_ prefix — both RP-new tasks and tasks adapted from NC. NC DIRECT transfers are re-issued under TSK_FCRP_* for prefix consistency within the RP spec.

expected_modules.notes: RP-SPECIFIC: Condition assessment module. Visual inspection, adhesion test (ASTM D3359), chalk rub test, moisture probe, mildew/algae scan, caulk assessment per 'Think Like a Water Drop' protocol. FIXED time tasks per elevation. Maps to 'prep' phase (no 'assessment' phase in controlled_enums).

Protection setup — landscape perimeter (LF-based), hardscape walk/patio, light fixture masking, HVAC cover, vehicle/driveway protection (spray only), equipment setup. RRP containment setup when pre_1978 + lead. Partially transfers from NC MOD_FCSD_SETUP.

RP-SPECIFIC: Low-pressure rinse (400-600 PSI max, wide fan tip — NO power washing on FC). Mildew/algae biocide treatment. TSP wash at QT4. Per-elevation FIXED task. 24-48 hr dry time after rinse before coating. CRITICAL departure from wood siding RP (1000-1500 PSI power wash).

Condition-driven surface prep: scrape/feather failing/peeling areas, degloss/scuff sound areas, chalk remediation, efflorescence treatment (FC-specific — dry brush + neutralize), mildew treatment follow-up, dust cleanup (including scraping debris collection). Condition scale drives prep intensity: GOOD=1.0x, FAIR=1.5x, POOR=2.0x.

RP-SPECIFIC: Separate caulk module due to high joint volume on FC siding. Assess all joints per elevation (siding-to-trim, butt joints, window/door perimeter, foundation transition) per 'Think Like a Water Drop' protocol. Remove failed caulk, clean joints, re-caulk with exterior-grade paintable caulk (polyurethane or siliconized acrylic), tool smooth. 2-4 hr cure before overcoating. LF-based rate with condition modifier.

State-driven + substrate-driven primer selection. SS_EXT_SOUND_PAINT: spot prime bare/thin areas only (alkali-resistant on exposed bare FC, standard acrylic elsewhere). SS_EXT_CHALKING: chalk-binding primer full surface. SS_EXT_FAILING_PAINT: alkali-resistant on exposed bare FC + acrylic stain-block on remaining. SS_EXT_PEELING: full alkali-resistant primer on bare FC + acrylic stain-block full surface. Skip prime entirely for GOOD condition with no bare areas and verified adhesion. Spray_backroll or brush_roll.

First finish coat — spray_backroll primary (2-person: sprayer leads, backroller follows within wet edge), brush_roll fallback. Transfers from NC MOD_FCSD_FINISH_1 with method change (spray_backroll replaces spray-only). Flat or satin, Hardie-approved products.

Intercoat inspection and maintenance. QT2: skipped (single coat). QT3: spot inspect for holidays/runs/overspray at 6-10 ft. QT4: full surface sand 220 grit between coats + systematic inspection at 6 ft. Touch-up defects. Transfers from NC MOD_FCSD_INTERSTAGE.
Second finish coat — QT3/QT4 only. Same method as first coat. QT2 skips (single coat). Transfers from NC MOD_FCSD_FINISH_2.

Final inspection and touch-up per elevation. QT2: ground-level quick scan. QT3: 6-10 ft walkthrough. QT4: systematic 6 ft inspection with binoculars for upper elevations. Transfers from NC MOD_FCSD_FINAL_INSPECT.

Protection teardown (landscape, hardscape, fixtures, HVAC, vehicle/driveway), equipment cleanup, site debris cleanup, RRP containment teardown (when applicable), customer walkthrough (RP-specific — occupied home context). Partially transfers from NC MOD_FCSD_CLEANUP.

Shared exterior lead-safe RRP module. Conditional on PS_EXT_META.FLAG.PRE_1978 = true. Per-elevation setup: 6-mil poly ground containment extending 10 ft from structure. Shared across all exterior RP specs. Pre-existing shared module — not owned by this spec. RRP is very rare for FC siding (introduced ~1987) but required for compliance when BUILDING is pre-1978.

paintscope_keys.description: Net paintable siding field area (excludes window/door openings, trim boards). Measured per elevation.
paintscope_keys.notes: From NC spec. Shared between NC and RP fiber cement siding specs and wood siding specs.

paintscope_keys.description: Total elevation count. Drives per-elevation fixed tasks (rinse, RRP containment setup/teardown, assessment).
Per-elevation access type (ground/ladder/scaffold/lift). Drives FAC_EXT_ACCESS height modifier on ALL tasks performed at elevation.
paintscope_keys.notes: Shared across exterior specs. A project may have different access types per elevation.

paintscope_keys.description: Siding profile type: lap, panel, shingle. Drives FAC_SIDING_PROFILE production rate modifier.
paintscope_keys.notes: Per-project attribute. Shared with NC fiber cement siding spec. Same physical characteristic — transfers unchanged.

paintscope_keys.description: Surface texture type: smooth, cedarmill, roughsawn. Drives FAC_SURFACE_TEXTURE production rate AND material quantity modifier.
paintscope_keys.notes: Per-project attribute. Shared with NC fiber cement siding spec. Same physical characteristic — transfers unchanged.

paintscope_keys.description: Exterior substrate state: SS_EXT_SOUND_PAINT, SS_EXT_CHALKING, SS_EXT_FAILING_PAINT, SS_EXT_PEELING. Worst-state-wins per v1.
paintscope_keys.notes: Shared across all exterior RP specs. Per-elevation attribute if conditions differ across building faces. Maps to condition scale: GOOD/FAIR/POOR.

paintscope_keys.description: Boolean flag: home built before 1978. Triggers RRP lead-safe module. Project-level flag.
paintscope_keys.notes: Shared across all exterior RP specs. RRP is very rare for FC siding (introduced ~1987) but required for compliance when BUILDING is pre-1978.

paintscope_keys.description: Linear feet of house perimeter where landscape is adjacent and requires protection. LF-based for siding (per UC-001 from NC).
paintscope_keys.notes: From NC spec. Siding uses LF-based landscape protection (you measure the run along the house, not the area). RP protection also covers scraping debris and rinse water runoff.

paintscope_keys.description: Walkway protection area adjacent to siding. Canvas drop cloths for non-slip crew traffic.
paintscope_keys.notes: Shared across exterior specs. Upgrades to full_cover for spray or RRP.

paintscope_keys.description: Patio protection area adjacent to siding.
paintscope_keys.notes: Shared across exterior specs. Upgrades to full_cover for spray or RRP.

paintscope_keys.description: Count of exterior light fixtures to mask on siding elevations.
paintscope_keys.notes: Shared with NC siding spec and other exterior specs.

paintscope_keys.description: Count of HVAC units adjacent to siding requiring cover during spray operations.

Total linear feet of caulk joints requiring assessment and potential replacement per project. Estimator measures all joint types: siding-to-trim, butt joints, window/door perimeter, foundation transition.
paintscope_keys.notes: RP-SPECIFIC: FC siding has significantly more caulk joints than wood siding. This is a major labor line item. Typical residential: 200-500 LF per project. Condition drives replacement percentage: GOOD = near-zero replacement, FAIR = moderate, POOR = extensive.

paintscope_keys.description: Vehicle/driveway overspray protection area. Required when spray_backroll application and vehicles/driveway are adjacent.
paintscope_keys.notes: RP-SPECIFIC: Occupied home context. Spray overspray on vehicles is a liability. Follows wood siding RP pattern.

quality_tier.notes: QT5 excluded — siding field is utilitarian surface, not fine-finish millwork. Per Exterior_Substrates_Doctrine section 5.4. QT2=economy (single finish coat). QT3=standard (2 finish coats per Hardie warranty). QT4=premium (2 finish coats + interstage sand + premium materials). QT modifiers: QT2=1.0x, QT3=1.0x (baseline), QT4=1.15x on qt_scaled tasks.

application_method.notes: spray_backroll is PRIMARY for RP fiber cement (departure from NC spray-only). Existing painted surface is no longer factory-smooth — backroll works product into surface irregularities for maximum adhesion. 2-person operation: sprayer leads, backroller follows within wet edge. brush_roll is fallback for <750 SF, occupied-adjacent, or high wind. spray (without backroll) NOT valid for RP — backroll is needed for adhesion. spray_backbrush NOT valid for FC siding.

sheen.notes: Flat (default) and satin. Semi-gloss and gloss NOT valid for siding field — reserved for trim and fine-finish surfaces. Same sheen range as NC.

phase.notes: Combined assessment + prep + prime + finish RP spec. Assessment tasks map to 'prep' phase. Caulk tasks map to 'prep' phase. No 'apply' phase — uses 'prime' and 'finish' directly.

unit_of_measure.notes: SF is primary UOM for siding field tasks. LF for caulk replacement and landscape perimeter protection. EA for protection items (fixtures, HVAC). FIXED for per-elevation tasks (rinse, assessment, RRP containment setup/teardown) and per-project tasks (customer walkthrough). No EA_ROOM — exterior does not use room concept.

substrate_state.notes: 4 exterior RP substrate states — same as SF_TRIM_EXT_RP, SF_WINDOW_EXT_RP, SF_SOFFIT_EXT_RP. SS_EXT_WEATHERED excluded — bare FC with no coating is NC territory. SS_EXT_STAINED_* excluded. All input states converge to painted output per selected sheen. Worst-state-wins per v1. Per-elevation if conditions differ across building faces.

condition_scale.notes: Universal 3-level condition scale. Drives prep pool modifier: GOOD=1.0x, FAIR=1.5x, POOR=2.0x on prep tasks ONLY. Chalking is the most common FC RP degradation mode (mapped to FAIR). POOR maps to active delamination with exposed bare FC.

consumable_category.notes: All categories valid for FC siding RP. 'tool' covers assessment kit and carbide scraper. 'prep' covers deglosser, biocide. 'fill_material' covers caulk. 'protection' covers landscape tarps, drop cloths, poly sheeting.

product_role.notes: Primer = state-driven RP primers (chalk-binding, acrylic stain-block, alkali-resistant for bare FC, bonding for ColorPlus substrate). Finish = QT-driven exterior acrylic systems. Specialty = biocide, end-cut edge sealer (for edge wicking damage repair).

protection_level.notes: edge_only for landscape in brush_roll mode. full_cover for landscape/hardscape in spray_backroll mode or when scraping generates debris. light_mask for light fixtures. full_cover for HVAC units. full_containment for RRP.

typical_relationship.notes: different_finish: trim (corner boards, frieze, casings) vs siding colors. varies: foundation (may or may not be painted).

modifier_mechanism.notes: QT3=baseline (1.0x), QT4=selective_multiplier (1.15x on qt_scaled tasks). Condition modifiers: GOOD=baseline, FAIR=selective_multiplier (1.5x on prep), POOR=selective_multiplier (2.0x on prep). RRP=selective_multiplier (2.0x on prep tasks with paint disturbance).

surface_ids.notes: All surface IDs exist in id_registry surface_ids entries_in_active_use. siding_field: primary paintable surface. soffit_field: at eave line junction. ext_trim_frieze, ext_trim_corner, ext_trim_window_casing, ext_trim_door_casing: trim elements framing siding. foundation_wall: below siding, not in scope. In RP, all adjacent surfaces are almost always already finished — protection is mandatory.

zone_ids.notes: LF-based landscape perimeter protection along house where landscape is adjacent. RP scope includes scraping debris and rinse water runoff containment beyond NC overspray coverage. Follows NC siding spec pattern (UC-001: LF-based, not SF-based). Upgrades to full_cover for spray_backroll. Note: NC spec uses 'ext_landscape_perimeter' in protection_zones_required; zone_ids in id_registry only has 'ext_landscape_adjacent' — this is the LF-based variant for siding.
Walkway/hardscape adjacent to siding. Canvas drop cloths for non-slip crew traffic. Upgrades to full_cover for spray_backroll or RRP. Shared across exterior specs.
Patio adjacent to siding. Upgrades to full_cover for spray_backroll or RRP. Shared across exterior specs.
Exterior light fixtures on siding elevations. Bag or tape over fixture. Shared with NC siding spec.
HVAC units adjacent to siding. Full tarp cover during spray_backroll operations. Shared with NC siding spec.

RP-SPECIFIC: Vehicle and driveway overspray protection. Required when spray_backroll application and vehicles/driveway are adjacent. Occupied home context — NC does not typically need this. Follows wood siding RP pattern.

RP-SPECIFIC: General ground protection below siding work zone. Catches scraping debris, rinse water runoff, and paint drips. Wider coverage than NC landscape-only because RP generates debris during prep. Shared with other exterior RP specs.
RP-SPECIFIC: EPA RRP Rule containment. 6-mil poly extending 10 ft from structure. Required when pre_1978 + lead. Per-elevation setup. Shared across all exterior RP specs. Very rare for FC siding.

existing_systems_to_reuse.notes: Reuse NC alkali-resistant primer (SW Loxon Masonry Primer) for spot prime on exposed bare FC areas at pH 13.0. Same product, spot application in RP (on scraped-to-bare areas) vs full surface in NC. Required for SS_EXT_PEELING and SS_EXT_FAILING_PAINT when scraping exposes bare FC.

Reuse NC bonding primer for spot prime on exposed factory-finished (ColorPlus/ExpertFinish) substrate. Triggered when RP scraping exposes original oven-baked factory finish rather than standard factory-primed surface. Secondary/rare primer path.
Reuse NC standard finish at QT2/QT3. Same Hardie-approved products (SW Duration or equivalent). RP application is spray_backroll vs NC spray-only — product is unchanged, application method differs.
Reuse NC premium finish at QT4. Same premium products (SW Emerald, BM Aura). RP application is spray_backroll. Interstage sand between coats at QT4.

proposed_systems.name: Chalk-Binding Primer for Chalking Exterior Fiber Cement Siding
proposed_systems.notes: RP-SPECIFIC: Full-surface chalk-binding primer for SS_EXT_CHALKING condition. Penetrates and binds loose chalk layer to create adhesion surface for topcoat. Chalking is the most common FC siding RP degradation mode. Reference products: SW PrimeRx Peel Bonding Primer, Zinsser Peel Stop. May share with SYS_PRIMER_EXT_CHALK_BINDING from other exterior RP specs — Materials Manager to verify.

proposed_systems.name: Acrylic Stain-Block Primer for Fiber Cement Siding Repaint
proposed_systems.notes: RP-SPECIFIC: Acrylic stain-block adhesion primer for general RP application over feathered and scuff-sanded areas. Full surface for SS_EXT_PEELING (in combination with alkali-resistant on bare FC areas), spot for localized SS_EXT_FAILING_PAINT. Different from NC SYS_EXT_FC_PRIMER_ACRYLIC (bare substrate) — this is for existing paint with adhesion concerns. Reference products: SW PrepRite ProBlock, Zinsser Bulls Eye 1-2-3. May share with SYS_PRIMER_EXT_ACRYLIC_STAINBLOCK from other exterior RP specs — Materials Manager to verify.

material_system_prefix.notes: 4 NC material systems reused directly (1 substrate-specific primer for exposed bare FC + 1 bonding primer for ColorPlus substrate + 2 QT-driven finishes). 2 RP-specific primer systems proposed (chalk-binding for chalking + acrylic stain-block for general RP adhesion). NC SYS_EXT_FC_PRIMER_ACRYLIC is NOT directly reusable — it is for bare factory-primed substrate, not for existing paint. RP needs acrylic stain-block over existing paint.

proposed_consumables.name: 18-inch Roller Cover for Backroll (3/8 nap)
proposed_consumables.notes: RP-SPECIFIC: 18-inch roller cover for spray_backroll operation. Follows product into surface for adhesion. 3/8 nap for smooth FC, 1/2 nap for cedarmill/roughsawn. NC does not backroll — this consumable is RP-only.

proposed_consumables.name: Exterior Polyurethane Paintable Caulk
proposed_consumables.notes: RP-SPECIFIC: Higher-performance caulk for RP joint replacement. Polyurethane or siliconized acrylic — better adhesion and flexibility than standard caulk for re-caulking applications. 10.3 oz tube covers ~20-25 LF of 1/4-inch bead. Typical project: 8-15 tubes.

proposed_consumables.name: Efflorescence Neutralizer (Dilute Acetic Acid)
proposed_consumables.notes: FC-SPECIFIC: For neutralizing heavy efflorescence deposits on fiber cement. Dilute acetic acid (vinegar solution) or commercial efflorescence remover. Apply, dwell, rinse. Not needed for wood siding RP.

consumable_prefix.notes: Most consumables reuse existing IDs from NC fiber cement spec and shared RP consumable pool. CON_DEGLOSS_LIQUID, CON_ASSESSMENT_KIT, CON_BIOCIDE_SOLUTION, CON_SCRAPER_CARBIDE, CON_POLY_SHEETING_6MIL proposed by exterior window RP and soffit RP — reuse those. 3 new FC-RP-specific consumables: 18-inch backroll cover, polyurethane caulk, efflorescence neutralizer.

proposed_rounds.description: 2 finish coats only — GOOD condition, no prime needed. Sound paint with verified adhesion.
proposed_rounds.notes: Skip prime when adhesion test passes, existing paint is sound, no bare areas. Cosmetic refresh or color change on well-maintained FC siding. Common RP scenario for sound-paint FC.

proposed_rounds.description: 1 finish coat only — economy QT2, GOOD condition.
proposed_rounds.notes: Economy single-coat FC siding RP on sound paint. Minimum viable scope. QT2 only.

proposed_rounds.description: State-driven prime + 2 finish coats — FAIR/POOR condition requiring primer.
proposed_rounds.notes: Standard RP round for FC siding with chalking, failing paint, or peeling. Prime coat is state-driven: chalk-binding for SS_EXT_CHALKING, acrylic stain-block + alkali-resistant on bare FC for SS_EXT_FAILING_PAINT/SS_EXT_PEELING. Most common RP round for FAIR/POOR condition.

proposed_rounds.description: State-driven prime + 1 finish coat — economy QT2, FAIR/POOR condition.
proposed_rounds.notes: Economy RP with prime needed. Single finish coat on primed surface. QT2 budget scenario on degraded FC siding.

proposed_profiles.description: Coverage rate for chalk-binding primer on chalking FC siding surface. Thicker-bodied product with lower coverage per gallon.
proposed_profiles.notes: RP-SPECIFIC: Chalk-binding primer has lower coverage (~200-300 SF/gal) due to thicker body required for chalk penetration. Surface texture modifier applies (cedarmill/roughsawn absorb more).

proposed_profiles.description: Coverage rate for acrylic stain-block primer on previously painted FC siding surface.
proposed_profiles.notes: RP-SPECIFIC: Higher coverage than NC primer on bare substrate because RP surfaces are partially sealed by existing paint. ~300-400 SF/gal. Surface texture modifier applies.

proposed_profiles.description: Coverage rate for finish coat on repainted FC siding surface via spray_backroll.
proposed_profiles.notes: RP-SPECIFIC: spray_backroll has slightly lower transfer efficiency than NC spray-only. Coverage may be ~5-10% lower than COV_FCSD_FINISH due to backroll redistribution. Materials Manager to evaluate whether COV_FCSD_FINISH is reusable or a separate RP profile is needed.

existing_modifiers_to_reuse.notes: Shared RP modifier. Drives prep pool: GOOD=1.0x, FAIR=1.5x, POOR=2.0x. Applies to prep tasks ONLY — NOT coating tasks. Same values as all other exterior RP specs.
Shared exterior modifier. ground=1.00, ladder=1.35, scaffold=1.60, lift=1.50. Per-elevation attribute. Applies to ALL per-SF tasks in both prep and coating pools. Transfers from NC unchanged.

existing_modifiers_from_nc.notes: From NC fiber cement and wood siding specs. Physical characteristic — transfers unchanged to RP. lap=1.00, panel=1.10, shingle=2.00. Applied to prep and coating tasks. Shingle is dramatically slower (complex geometry, constant repositioning).

From NC fiber cement spec. Physical characteristic — transfers unchanged to RP. smooth=1.00, cedarmill=1.20, roughsawn=1.30. Affects both production rate AND material consumption. Textured profiles trap more paint in valleys.

proposed_modifiers.notes: RP-SPECIFIC: RRP modifier for prep tasks involving paint disturbance. no_rrp=1.00, rrp_required=2.00. Binary gate (pre_1978 + lead-positive = activate). Applied to scrape, feather-sand, rinse with paint removal, degloss/scuff. NOT applied to assessment, coating, inspection, or cleanup. Calibrated to 2.0x per established exterior RP pattern (RC-001). Very rare for FC siding but required for EPA compliance.

prep_pool.formula: condition_modifier x rrp_modifier x access_modifier x profile_modifier x texture_modifier
prep_pool.max_theoretical: POOR(2.0) x RRP(2.0) x scaffold(1.60) x shingle(2.00) x roughsawn(1.30) = 16.64x
prep_pool.flag_note: Max theoretical is extreme and would never occur in practice (RRP + scaffold + shingle + roughsawn is unrealistic combination — FC shingle is rare, RRP on FC is rare, scaffold + RRP + POOR shingle roughsawn is near-impossible). Recommend T&M for any combination exceeding 4.0x. Realistic worst: FAIR(1.5) x no_RRP(1.0) x ladder(1.35) x lap(1.0) x cedarmill(1.20) = 2.43x (within cap).

coating_pool.formula: qt_modifier x access_modifier x profile_modifier x texture_modifier
coating_pool.max_theoretical: QT4(1.15) x scaffold(1.60) x shingle(2.00) x roughsawn(1.30) = 4.78x
coating_pool.flag_note: Exceeds 4.0x cap at scaffold + shingle + roughsawn — recommend T&M for this combination. Same as NC finding. Common high: QT3(1.0) x ladder(1.35) x lap(1.0) x cedarmill(1.20) = 1.62x (within cap).

coordination_notes: FC siding RP runs alongside SF_TRIM_EXT_RP which covers corner boards, frieze, window/door casings. Caulk at siding-to-trim junctions is THIS spec's responsibility.

Low-pressure rinse ownership: per-elevation task. If rinse already performed by another spec on same elevation, skip. Cross-spec deduplication rule (U-003). Note: FC siding uses LOW-PRESSURE rinse (400-600 PSI), not the power wash (1000-1500 PSI) used by wood siding and trim RP specs — cannot share a wash pass.
Landscape/hardscape protection zones shared with SF_TRIM_EXT_RP and other exterior RP specs. Protection setup owned by first spec in elevation sequence (U-004).
RRP containment is shared across all exterior RP specs — do not duplicate containment tasks. Per-elevation setup. MOD_RRP_EXT_CONTAINMENT is shared module.
Height/access modifiers (FAC_EXT_ACCESS) are per-elevation attributes — one building may have different access types on different elevations.
Window/door protection during siding work is owned by window/door RP specs, not this spec. If windows/doors are in RP scope, their specs handle glass/hardware masking.
In RP, all adjacent surfaces (trim, soffit, foundation) are almost always already finished — protection is mandatory for BOTH spray_backroll and brush_roll methods.
Vehicle/driveway protection zone is RP-specific — occupied home context. Shared with other exterior RP specs that use spray application.

cross_file_threading: RULE 1: Every TSK_ in sop_modules.json MUST have a matching rate in production.json
RULE 2: Every ITM_ in spec.json MUST appear in at least one variant
RULE 3: Every SYS_ quality_tier MUST match spec.json configuration_dimensions
RULE 4: Every IN_ input in spec.json SHOULD be consumed by sop_modules or production
RULE 5: Every PS_ key in production.json MUST match spec.json required_paintscope_inputs
RULE 6: Every zone_id in spec.json MUST match sop_modules.json protection_metadata.zones
RULE 7: Module phase order: setup -> prep -> prime -> apply -> interstage -> finish -> cleanup
RULE 8: UOM for a task MUST match between sop_modules.json and production.json
RULE 9: ALL tasks MUST use TSK_FCRP_ prefix — no NC TSK_FCSD_* transfers without re-prefixing
RULE 10: ITM_SIDING_FIELD MUST be used exactly as listed in this resolution's paintable_items
RULE 11: Downstream agents MUST use only enum values from this resolution's applicable_enums

registry_additions_proposed.name: Exterior Fiber Cement Siding Repaint (Combined Assessment + Prep + Prime + Finish)
registry_additions_proposed.justification: New spec family for exterior fiber cement siding repaint. Covers previously painted FC siding field (James Hardie HardiePlank, HardieShingle, HardiePanel). Distinct scope from NC (SF_SIDING_FIBERCEMENT_EXT_NC) — RP adds condition assessment, state-driven prep, chalk remediation, caulk assessment/replacement, mildew treatment, RRP containment, customer walkthrough, and spray_backroll application method.

registry_additions_proposed.name: Exterior Fiber Cement Siding Repaint Task Prefix
registry_additions_proposed.justification: New context prefix FCRP for FC siding RP tasks (~42 total). Avoids collision with TSK_FCSD_* (NC fiber cement siding, 25 tasks) and TSK_SDNG_* (NC wood siding, 30 tasks). Verified zero existing usage of TSK_FCRP_* in id_registry.

registry_additions_proposed.name: Exterior Fiber Cement Siding Repaint Module Prefix
registry_additions_proposed.justification: New module prefix for 11 FCRP modules (assess, setup, clean, prep, caulk, prime, finish_1, interstage, finish_2, final, cleanup) + shared MOD_RRP_EXT_CONTAINMENT. Avoids collision with MOD_FCSD_* (NC fiber cement siding, 8 modules).

registry_additions_proposed.name: Siding Profile Type (ENUM)
registry_additions_proposed.justification: PaintScope key for siding profile (lap/panel/shingle). Shared with NC fiber cement siding spec. Physical characteristic captured per project. NC spec uses this as a configuration dimension; RP needs it as a formal PaintScope key.

registry_additions_proposed.name: Surface Texture Type (ENUM)
registry_additions_proposed.justification: PaintScope key for surface texture (smooth/cedarmill/roughsawn). Shared with NC fiber cement siding spec. Physical characteristic captured per project.

registry_additions_proposed.name: Siding Profile Type Input (ENUM)
registry_additions_proposed.justification: Input mapped to PS_EXT_META.ENUM.SIDING_PROFILE. ENUM UOM (lap/panel/shingle).

registry_additions_proposed.name: Surface Texture Type Input (ENUM)
registry_additions_proposed.justification: Input mapped to PS_EXT_META.ENUM.SURFACE_TEXTURE. ENUM UOM (smooth/cedarmill/roughsawn).

registry_additions_proposed.name: Caulk Joint Linear Footage (LF)
registry_additions_proposed.justification: RP-SPECIFIC PaintScope key for total LF of caulk joints requiring assessment/replacement. FC siding has significantly more caulk joints than wood siding — this is a major labor line item. Manual capture input by estimator.

registry_additions_proposed.name: Caulk Joint Linear Footage Input (LF)
registry_additions_proposed.justification: Input mapped to PS_EXT_META.EA.CAULK_JOINTS. LF UOM. Typical residential: 200-500 LF per project.

registry_additions_proposed.name: Vehicle/Driveway Overspray Protection Area (SF)
registry_additions_proposed.justification: RP-SPECIFIC PaintScope key for vehicle and driveway overspray protection in occupied home context. Required when spray_backroll application and vehicles/driveway are adjacent.

registry_additions_proposed.name: Vehicle/Driveway Protection Area Input (SF)
registry_additions_proposed.justification: Input mapped to PS_EXT_PROTECT_SF.VEHICLE_DRIVEWAY. SF UOM.

registry_additions_proposed.name: Chalk-Binding Primer for Chalking Exterior Fiber Cement Siding
registry_additions_proposed.justification: RP-SPECIFIC primer system for SS_EXT_CHALKING — most common FC siding RP scenario. No existing SYS_ covers FC-specific chalk-binding primer. May share product with SYS_PRIMER_EXT_CHALK_BINDING from other RP specs — Materials Manager to verify.

registry_additions_proposed.name: Acrylic Stain-Block Primer for Fiber Cement Siding Repaint
registry_additions_proposed.justification: RP-SPECIFIC acrylic stain-block primer for general RP adhesion on failing/peeling FC siding. Distinct from NC SYS_EXT_FC_PRIMER_ACRYLIC (bare substrate) — this is for existing paint with adhesion concerns. May share with SYS_PRIMER_EXT_ACRYLIC_STAINBLOCK from other RP specs — Materials Manager to verify.

registry_additions_proposed.name: FC Siding RP: 2 Finish Coats (No Prime, GOOD Condition)
registry_additions_proposed.justification: RP GOOD condition round — skip prime when adhesion verified on sound exterior paint.

registry_additions_proposed.name: FC Siding RP: 1 Finish Coat (Economy QT2, GOOD Condition)
registry_additions_proposed.justification: Economy single-coat RP on sound paint. Minimum viable scope for FC siding.

registry_additions_proposed.name: FC Siding RP: State-Driven Prime + 2 Finish Coats (FAIR/POOR Condition)
registry_additions_proposed.justification: Standard RP round with condition-driven prime for chalking, failing, or peeling FC siding.

registry_additions_proposed.name: FC Siding RP: State-Driven Prime + 1 Finish Coat (Economy QT2, FAIR/POOR)
registry_additions_proposed.justification: Economy RP with prime needed. QT2 single finish coat on primed surface.

registry_additions_proposed.name: Chalk-Binding Primer Coverage on Chalking FC Siding
registry_additions_proposed.justification: RP-specific coverage rate — chalk-binding primer has lower coverage (~200-300 SF/gal) due to thicker body.

registry_additions_proposed.name: Acrylic Stain-Block Primer Coverage on Painted FC Siding
registry_additions_proposed.justification: RP-specific coverage rate — primer on previously painted surfaces differs from NC bare-substrate coverage.

registry_additions_proposed.name: Finish Coat Coverage on Repainted FC Siding via Spray_Backroll
registry_additions_proposed.justification: RP-specific finish coverage. spray_backroll has slightly lower transfer efficiency than NC spray-only. Materials Manager to evaluate reusability of COV_FCSD_FINISH.

registry_additions_proposed.name: RRP Modifier for FC Siding Prep Tasks
registry_additions_proposed.justification: RP-specific modifier: 2.0x on prep tasks involving paint disturbance when RRP required. Very rare for FC siding but required for EPA compliance. Calibrated per established exterior RP pattern (RC-001). May share with generic FAC_EXT_RRP if one emerges across RP specs.

registry_additions_proposed.name: LF-Based Landscape Perimeter Protection Zone
registry_additions_proposed.justification: LF-based variant of ext_landscape_adjacent for siding specs. NC siding spec (UC-001) established that siding landscape protection is LF-based (perimeter run) not SF-based (area). Used in NC protection_zones_required but not yet in zone_ids active entries. Formalize in zone_ids.

registry_additions_proposed.name: Vehicle/Driveway Overspray Protection Zone
registry_additions_proposed.justification: RP-specific zone for occupied home context. Vehicle and driveway overspray protection during spray_backroll application. Not needed for NC (unoccupied construction). Shared with other exterior RP specs using spray application.

registry_additions_proposed.name: 18-inch Roller Cover for Spray_Backroll (3/8 nap)
registry_additions_proposed.justification: RP-specific consumable for spray_backroll operation. NC does not backroll FC siding. 18-inch cover for full-width passes.

registry_additions_proposed.name: Exterior Polyurethane Paintable Caulk
registry_additions_proposed.justification: RP-specific higher-performance caulk for joint replacement. Polyurethane provides better adhesion and flexibility than standard caulk for re-caulking applications on FC siding.

registry_additions_proposed.name: Efflorescence Neutralizer (Dilute Acetic Acid)
registry_additions_proposed.justification: FC-specific prep consumable for neutralizing efflorescence deposits. Not needed for wood siding RP (wood does not produce efflorescence).
